full_name: James Mallet | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2009–2010 Biological Sciences Helen Putnam Fellow University College London (United Kingdom)
bio: James Mallet is a professor of biological diversity at University College London who would like to understand the origins and maintenance of the diversity of life on this planet.
